title: gatekeeper: enforce profile-stability on onboarding + generate concise release blurbs
author: Ravi Kapoor
description: This PR introduces an onboarding 'gatekeeper' that prevents model variants with unstable or under-specified performance profiles from being promoted into the registry's public catalog, and a small 'scribe' component that generates a concise, human-friendly release blurb for every accepted profile change. Motivation: we've seen a recurring class of post-onboard regressions where models with sparse eval vectors or high variance on core prompts make it into releases; operators then have to manually revert and write release notes. The gatekeeper enforces a stability score computed from profile metadata (sample size, eval variance, pass-rate across critical prompt sets) and a minimal metadata completeness policy. The scribe generates a 1-2 sentence blurb and a one-line bullet list of noticeable changes for CHANGELOG.md and for the Console release feed. Key behaviors: - Block onboarding if stability_score < threshold (configurable per-team); fail fast with clear actionable diagnostics. - Attach a compact 'profile snapshot' (hash + short diff) to the release bundle for auditability. - Emit a draft release blurb using templated natural-language rules with safe fallbacks when metrics are missing. - Provide a dry-run mode for CI and a webhook to auto-post candidate blurbs to a Linear ticket for review. Implementation notes: - gatekeeper implemented as registry/onboard/gatekeeper.py; relies on a new profile_schema.json and a lightweight scorer module (registry/onboard/stability.py). - scribe implemented as registry/release/scribe.py with templates and a micro-test-suite. - Integrated gates into onboarding workflow (ci/workflows/onboard.yml) and added a release-blurb workflow (ci/workflows/release_blurb.yml). Backwards compatibility: existing onboarding flows default to permissive mode until a team opts in via registry-config to enforce gating; configuration is per-space. Checklist: - [x] Stability scoring prototype - [x] Schema additions and validators - [x] Release blurb templates + tests - [x] CI integration (dry-run and enforced modes) - [x] Docs and migration notes (docs/onboarding/gatekeeping.md) Related: ENG-1287 (onboard regressions audit), ENG-1293 (release notes automation).

review_comments: Elena Gomez: Nice approach — can we make the stability threshold a floating window (rolling N evals) rather than a hard threshold? I worry about noisy metrics on small sample sizes.
Ravi Kapoor: Good point, added a config knob 'rolling_window' and documented expected default (N=5). Also included a dry-run mode so teams can observe gate behavior without blocking.

Liam O'Connor: scribe blurbs look good. A couple of suggestions: 1) Avoid model size in the blurb if it's not part of the profile metadata; 2) Include a link to the profile snapshot for easy inspection.
Ravi Kapoor: Addressed both — scribe falls back to 'unspecified' when metadata is missing; snapshot link is attached to the release bundle and included in the blurb when present.
Priya Narayanan (approved): Tests look solid; minor nits in docs. Approving to merge after CI green.

release_notes: Add configurable onboarding gatekeeper that enforces a profile stability score to prevent low-confidence models from being published; automatic short release blurbs and profile snapshots are generated for accepted onboardings. Opt-in via registry-config; see docs/onboarding/gatekeeping.md for migration steps.
notes_for_ops: Ops: When enabling enforcement, recommend enabling dry-run for 2 weeks and monitoring 'gate_reject' metric in Console under registry.onboarding. Default rolling_window=5 and default stability_threshold=0.7; tune per workload.
